title: Anna's Week
text:
Anna has a busy week. On Monday, she goes to school. On Tuesday, she plays football with her friends. On Wednesday, she visits her grandmother.

On Saturday, Anna goes to the park with her dad. On Sunday, the family cooks lunch together. Sunday is a special day for them. Anna likes it very much.

questions.text: What does Anna do on Tuesday?
options: She plays football with her friends.

questions.text: Who does Anna go to the park with on Saturday?
What kind of week does Anna have?
Why does the family cook lunch together on Sunday?
options: They want to spend time together
They have no food at home
They are going on a trip

vocabulary.definition: having a lot of things to do
the mother of your mother or father
with another person or other people

paragraph_translations: Anna'nın meşgul bir haftası var. Pazartesi günü okula gidiyor. Salı günü arkadaşlarıyla futbol oynuyor. Çarşamba günü büyükannesini ziyaret ediyor.
Cumartesi günü Anna babasıyla parka gidiyor. Pazar günü aile birlikte öğle yemeği pişiriyor. Pazar onlar için özel bir gün. Anna bunu çok seviyor.
